{{Quote|An unexplored world is a hostile world. I must help the Wookiee leader Attichitcuk to learn the lay of the land. Only then can we find an appropriate place to settle.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=HelpingAttichitcuk.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Alaris Prime''', also known as '''Alaris''' for short, was a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. The moon was notable for the abundant resources to be found amidst its expansive [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] [[Water/Legends|oceans]]. It was also home to several unique [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Gnasp/Legends|gnasps]] and [[Maru/Legends|Maru]]. Alaris Prime was untouched by civilizations for eons, and sometime after a [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|skirmish]] on the moon, during the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1002 BBY]], the moon disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view. Almost 950 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later it was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] from the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

A petition was made to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to grant [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] rights, which were eventually granted to the Wookiees after twenty years of debate. The Wookiee colonization was launched between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], led by the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. There, the Wookiees learned to gather the moon's natural resources and also became engaged in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who sought to [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegally]] subvert Attichictuk's claim. After a united offensive removed the Federation from the moon in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], the Wookiees retained their colonies there, making the world a thriving technological hub in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Alaris Prime was the site of multiple invasions from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the first month of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The [[battle on Alaris]] involved the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of most of the moon's population and the testing of an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact; the [[Force Harvester]]. The Wookiees were liberated with the help of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The [[Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)|next battle]] targeted the production facilities of the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]], a war machine built by the Wookiees.

==Description==
{{Quote|Alaris Prime must be a rich world indeed.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alarisprime.jpg|thumb|left|Alaris Prime]]
Alaris Prime was the first<ref name="GB" /> of eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]],<ref name="TEA" /> located within the [[Alaris Expanse]] in the outer arm of the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="GB" /> In the [[Star system/Legends|system]] resided the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kashyyyk (star)/Legends|Kashyyyk]], of which Alaris held the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position. The system was part of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and lay on the intersection of several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]; the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]], the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]], the [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]], and the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]].<ref name="TEA" />

Alaris Prime was hidden from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view because of its small size compared to Alaris, causing it to be untouched by civilizations for [[Time/Legends|eons]]. In spite of its isolation, the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]], thought to be native from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the same system, were also found on Alaris Prime,<ref name="GB" /> though they were smaller than those on Kashyyyk due to the moon's different climate.<ref name="Kashyyyk moon">{{LucasArts|url=products/starwarstheclonewars/gameplay/kashyyyk.htm|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Kashyyyk Moon}}</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from Kashyyyk created several legends about how the trees could have migrated across [[Realspace/Legends|space]] but no accepted scientific theory developed. The moon was covered in thick [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and temperate [[Water/Legends|oceans]] and was rich in natural resources,<ref name="GB" /> with its stockpiles of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits making it a desirable target for [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> [[Muja fruit/Legends|Muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] also grew there.<ref name="GB" />

Alaris Prime was home to a multitude of [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="GB" /> including many dangerous predators<ref name="Kashyyyk moon" /> such as swarms of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Gnasp/Legends|Gnasps]], the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Maru/Legends|Maru]],<ref name="CW" /> [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], and [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. Several edible species also lived there including [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]], and abundant schools of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] in the oceans. After the moon was colonized by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from Kashyyyk several settlements were built there.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|This world is supposed to be uncolonized.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=AlarisUncolonized.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
During the [[War against Zakuul|conflict]] with the [[Eternal Empire]]<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Hunting Party}}</ref> in [[3630 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> two [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] clans finished a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] competition on Alaris Prime. While they took the trophies with themselves, the [[Death/Legends|corpses]] of the unfortunate hunters were left behind.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Hunting Party}}</ref>

In [[1002 BBY]], during the [[New Sith Wars]], an elite force for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] known as the [[Gloom Walkers]] was on patrol on Alaris Prime when they were [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|ambushed]] by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After only a few minutes of fighting the Republic forces, it broke ranks and fled. The ambush resulted in several casualties on both sides, including the Gloom Walkers' [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ulabore]], whose execution by [[Gender/Legends|his]] subordinate [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]] for an earlier grievance went unreported. Sometime after the skirmish<ref name="DoE" /> Alaris Prime disappeared from galactic view and was forgotten. At some point an [[ancient grove]] and a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|holocron]] associated with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were left on the moon.<ref name="GB" />

In his adolescence, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] made visits to Alaris Prime to shoot at gnasps. He took pleasure at watching them explode mid-flight and considered it good practice in [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-[[Eye/Legends|eye]] coordination when writing about it in his autobiography, ''[[Making a Killing]]''.<ref name="Bounty">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

===Colonization===
====Rediscovery, legislation and first contact====
{{Quote|I must help the Wookiee leader Attichitcuk to learn the lay of the land.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=LayOfTheLand.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] as portrayed in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' stated that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] took twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to distribute the colonization rights after Alaris Prime was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|discovered]], indicating that the discovery took place between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]]</ref> Alaris Prime was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] by Wookiee explorers from Kashyyyk. These Wookiees petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic for colonization rights to the moon, selecting the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] as their representative. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] also expressed interest in Alaris Prime,<ref name="GB" /> aware of its plentiful resources<ref name="Prima" /> and also hoping to use it as a trade center between planets such as [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], Kashyyyk, and [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Thalmussen_voyage.png|thumb|left|350px|The ''Thalmussen'' journeys to Alaris Prime.]]
After two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of debate, the Senate awarded the colonization rights to the Wookiees, which the Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] secretly rejected. He sent a portion of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] to begin colonizing Alaris Prime<ref name="GB" /> and establish a secret manufacturing operation there.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> One of the first structures built was a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], but when it came under attack from gundarks the Federation was driven from that area. Attichitcuk was selected as the leader of the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] as a reward for his senatorial representation, and he along with the multitude of other colonists departed for the moon aboard the ''[[Thalmussen]]'' and three other [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

After their ships landed in a clearing near a river Attichitcuk was the first Wookiee to personally explore Alaris Prime, where he established their first [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]] and left [[marker]]s to lead the way. He was followed by his [[Parent/Legends|son]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and nephew [[Shoran]], who encountered the Trade Federation's damaged power core. Their official [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], was surprised to see an artificial structure on an untouched world and advised the two Wookiees to destroy it. After doing so Attichitcuk's camp was [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attacked]] by gundarks, reminding the colonists of the dangers of their new world. The Trade Federation also returned to the damaged power core and made plans to deal with the gundarks using their Trandoshan allies.<ref name="GB" />

====The dangerous new world====
{{Quote|We have discovered our foes on this distant world. Our lessons are about to take a different path.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=AlarisFoes.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Wookiee colonists moved out to other bases, including one [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] where Jinn taught a group of workers on how to gather resources from Alaris Prime's available resources, including [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from bushes and wild animals, [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from trees, nova crystals and ore. Along with Chewbacca, these workers [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|fought off]] a group of gundarks, an attack that galvanized Jinn and the Wookiees into seeking a permanent solution to the problem. At another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|base]] near a forest, Chewbacca and Jinn trained a group of [[bowcaster trooper]]s and marched towards the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]], but [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] of the Trade Federation had already begun [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|exterminating]] the gundarks. These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] fired at the Wookiees on sight but were defeated by them.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Wookiee_attack.png|thumb|right|300px|Wookiees and droids go to war on Alaris Prime]]
With knowledge of a new enemy on Alaris Prime, the Wookiees and Jinn made preparations for battle, with Attichitcuk undertaking a scouting mission while Chewbacca worked on expanding the [[technology level]] of another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]] near a river. Attichitcuk was nearly [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|killed]] by the Trade Federation's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but Chewbacca launched a [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] mission that saved his father's life. Afterward, Attichitcuk stepped down as leader of the colonists and placed Chewbacca in charge, marking the beginning of concentrated offensives against the Trade Federation.<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca's first target was a [[Trade Federation outpost]] where battle droids were manufactured. In their [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]], his Wookiees built and used aquatic [[Transport Ship (Wookiee)|transport ships]] to cross a river to reach the outpost which was successfully [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|destroyed]]. Shoran and Chewbacca also established [[Shoran's camp|two]] [[Chewbacca's camp|camps]] with which to practice trading using [[Corellian HoverFreighter]]s and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Shoran also found the ancient Jedi holocron in his camp, which prompted Jinn to request permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to construct a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] in Chewbacca's camp, which was granted. With the temple built Jinn sent his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to retrieve the holocron, as only a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] individual could carry it. While he was out Chewbacca's Wookiees had to repel another [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] from the Trade Federation.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:QGJ_Alaris_Prime.png|thumb|left|300px|Qui-Gon Jinn guided the Wookiee colonization of Alaris Prime.]]
After the holocron was placed in the Jedi temple scouts from Shoran's camp uncovered a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] used by the Trade Federation to monitor the Wookiees, which Shoran and Chewbacca's forces subsequently [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]]. Now that they were ready to organize a final offensive against the Trade Federation's last [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]], Jinn was conditionally approved by the Jedi Council to participate with his Wookiee friends as long as the Wookiees constructed a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in their [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]]. The Wookiees fortified their base and arranged the construction of the fortress. A fully revitalized Attichitcuk, Chewbacca, Shoran, and Jinn organized the last attack that saw the destruction of the Trade Federation fortress, expelling them in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

Free of war, Alaris Prime eventually became a significant technology hub in the Republic<ref name="GB" /> and was economically thriving under Chewbacca's leadership.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|106|Han Solo: The Early Years}}</ref> The Wookiees also colonized the other moons of Alaris,<ref name="TEA" /> which used the Middle-period [[Krorral]] architectural style.<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars and Imperial Period===
{{Quote|He says the Separatists have invaded the entire moon and enslaved most of the Wookiee population. This is one of the last remaining villages. They're willing to help us get in contact with the Republic if we help them get the Separatists out of the star system.|Bera Kazan, translating for a Wookiee on Alaris Prime to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="CW" />}}
[[File:First_Battle_of_Alaris_Prime.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Sev'rance Tann's forces on Alaris Prime]]
Wookiee engineers on Alaris Prime designed and produced the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] weapon system to aid the Republic in its ground battles.<ref name="CC" /> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the engineers' efforts made their home an early target of the Galactic Republic's enemy in the conflict: the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Within a month of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was taken to the moon by Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and mercenary [[Cydon Prax]]. Dooku intended to subject Skywalker and the population of Alaris Prime to a test of the [[Force Harvester]], the power source of the [[Dark Reaper]] superweapon. Skywalker was able to free the captive Wookiees and signal the Republic for help. Wookiee warriors initiated a holding maneuver until Republic reinforcements led by Obi-Wan Kenobi could arrive and defeat the Confederacy forces in the [[battle on Alaris]].<ref name="CW" />

The Wookiee colony had only quickly recovered from the battle when Alaris Prime came under siege again<ref name="NEC" /> by the forces of Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] in search of fail-safe codes for the Decimator technology, leading to a [[Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)|battle]] that destroyed several Wookiee colonies and the Decimator [[Decimator Facility|production facilities]].<ref name="CC" />

Throughout the Clone Wars tensions were raised about Kashyyyk's loyalty to the Republic, with diplomatic negotiations between Jedi and the Wookiee government ultimately keeping the system's alignment. However, the Wookiees refused the placement of Republic military bases on Kashyyyk in spite of the Separatist incursions on Alaris Prime, as the government considered them to be internal colonial affairs. This circumstance was reported in the [[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:10:03|14:10:03]] edition of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HoloNet">{{InsiderCite|71|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:10:03}}</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Force and Destiny" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a slave processing center on Alaris Prime was maintained by the Empire and the [[Trandoshan Slavers Guild]] to provide labor for Imperial construction projects.<ref name="Force and Destiny" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Therefore, Chewbacca has decided that the Trade Federation will have no place on Alaris Prime.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Wookiees_getting_food.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Wookiees gather food on Alaris Prime]]
Alaris Prime was uninhabited for eons prior to the Wookiee colonization, after which the Wookiees continued to maintain settlements there. The [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]]-speaking species<ref name="GB" /> was governed from the central government on Kashyyyk.<ref name="HoloNet" /> Using training from Qui-Gon Jinn the Wookiees grew to self-sufficiency, able to harvest the bountiful resources on Alaris Prime and train their own military.<ref name="GB" /> By the time of the Clone Wars, the Wookiees on Alaris Prime had taken to mounting the native maru to use as pack animals and war mounts, by equipping them with harnesses fitted with dual bowcasters and [[seismic pulse emitter]]s.<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Throughout the conflicts there, Alaris Prime also housed bases belonging to the Trade Federation<ref name="GB" /> and the Confederacy of Independent Systems,<ref name="CW" /> which were used by B1 battle droids, though these settlements did not have a lasting presence.<ref name="GB" /><ref name="CW" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|There are Wookiee camps throughout Alaris Prime, you must be cautious.|Count Dooku to Sev'rance Tann|<ref name="CC" />}}
During the war for its colonization Alaris Prime was host to various Wookiee and Trade Federation settlements.<ref name="GB" /> By the time of the Clone Wars the camps on Alaris Prime included [[Chendrrl]], [[Rwookawarrump]], [[Llamitcuk]], [[Tayriiwook]], and [[Rwaawrrkoo]].<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alaris Prime was created as the location of the Wookiee tutorial campaign for the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', and was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] published by [[Prima Games]]. The guide mistakenly referred to Alaris Prime as a planet.<ref name="Prima" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] placed the Kashyyyk system, including Alaris Prime, in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[2002]] LucasArts game [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] had several missions set on an unnamed moon of Kashyyyk.<ref name="CW" /> The game's section on the LucasArts website only referred to it as "Kashyyyk Moon," but listed ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' as a previous appearance, implying that the moon was Alaris Prime.<ref name="Kashyyyk moon" /> In [[2005]], ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' confirmed that the events of the game had occurred on Alaris Prime.<ref name="NEC" />

According to the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|core rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' Wookiees terraformed Alaris Prime over millennia to resemble Kashyyyk.<ref name="Force and Destiny" /> This conflicts with references to the lack of scientific explanation on how wroshyr trees were found on Alaris Prime made in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'',<ref name="GB" /> [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 42|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 42]],<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile|42|KAS 1-4|Kashyyyk}}</ref> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|17|Alaris Prime}}</ref>
